about: The rest of Survivor 51 as a season usually goes, from the week after the backup to a 13-episode finale: one voted out most weeks; a tribe swap at Episode 7 (also the week the clocks go back: it airs at 8 PM EST, the first episode after daylight time ends); an idol found at 8 and played at 10, cancelling the votes on its holder; the merge at 9 (the desk answers "When did Merged start?"), individual immunity from then on; a double boot at 11; a medical evacuation (out with no vote) beside a vote at 12; the finale votes down to four, fire-making to three, then the jury's Sole Survivor. The Drive-By changes a move five minutes before Episode 8 starts (taken) and five minutes after (refused). Any episode the backup hasn't reached and the scenario doesn't name is one voted out, tribe against tribe.
